formal_scope.target: Main inequality (M) in the zeta-specialized human exposition; a central arithmetic input to the chain from theta lifts / divisibility / size to a one-sided smoothed prime-sum bound
formal_scope.final_effect: Together with character estimates B and C, (M) yields a bound for G(x) on long intervals [Y,Y^(3/2)], which excludes zeros to the right of 1/2+epsilon.
formal_scope.not_a_claim: This fixture does not reconstruct all of (M), prove its quoted inputs, or claim Symthaea independently verified RH.

main_inequality.statement_lhs: (1/n) * sum_{u in H} sum_{t in T} sum_{j=1}^m (P_{u,t,j} - M_{u,t,j})
main_inequality.normalized_error: E/B ≤ x^(C ε) * (x/m + x m/k + m + k/n^2)
main_inequality.normalization: B = |T| m b δ / 2, with b=exp(x^ε), δ=|T2|/n
main_inequality.conceptual_role: The average arithmetic divisibility sum is bounded by a size-derived main term plus a controlled error. The error terms balance with m about sqrt(x). The log-weight term is forced by centering each residue cell's smoothed prime sum: its universal μ y log y part plus its cell-specific linear constant combine to the exact M expression, leaving only residuals.

quantities.name: P_{u,t,j}
quantities.meaning: Smoothed weighted sum over odd prime powers, with coefficient (1 - χ_d(p^h)) log p and positive-part cutoff (a_t / p^h - w_{u,j}(v(p^h), t[p^h]))_+.

quantities.name: M_{u,t,j}
quantities.meaning: Main term a_t (log a_t - 1 - γ + c_{χ_d} - average_cell(log w)).

quantities.name: E
quantities.meaning: Aggregate error from comparison of integral divisibility against complex size; the source splits it into four scale terms after normalization.

source_formulas.cell_smoothed_sum: S_i(y) = sum_{r in cell i} c(r) (y/r - 1)_+
source_formulas.cell_counting_function: Psi_i(z) = sum_{r in cell i, r <= z} c(r)
source_formulas.cell_decomposition: S_i(y) = μ y log y + C_i y + R_i(y)

density.raw_prime_density_per_cell: 1/(4n): one half nonsquare mod d, one half specified sign mod q, and 1/n specified residue-pair column; CRT gives independence over invertible residue classes
density.weight_coefficient: c(r) = (1-χ_d(r)) log p; coefficient is 2 log p on contributing ordinary primes, doubling the raw density
density.caveat: The source explicitly says the fixed-modulus PNT error O_A(z/(log z)^A) absorbs higher prime powers and the one exceptional prime. Its constants may depend on q,d,N. Uniformity as these moduli vary with x is not supplied by this fixed-modulus argument; Estimate C handles uniform nondistinguished-cell control later.

constants.source_reason: sum_i S_i(y) = S_1(y)-S_{χ_d}(y); the ordinary smoothed von Mangoldt sum has linear coefficient -1-γ, while the nonprincipal χ_d sum has linear coefficient -c_{χ_d}

weighted_recombination.logarithmic_part: μa sum_i log(a/w_i) = a log a - a <log w>, where <log w>=(1/(2n))sum_i log w_i

translation_average.reason: For a fixed column s=t[r], each z in T2 determines exactly one translate u=s z^{-1}; therefore exactly |T2| translates select that column. The row condition v(r)=1 is equivalent to χ_q(r)=1.
translation_average.weighted_consequence: (1/n) sum_u sum_{i distinguished at u} b S_i(a/b) = (δ b/2) S_{q,d}(a/b)
translation_average.residual_consequence: By linearity of subtracting the common logarithmic and linear centering terms, the same identity holds for residuals R_i and R_{q,d}.
caveats: This exact identity assumes the finite group H and the stated T2 subset construction.

The replacement of actual distinguished weights by b, the control of nondistinguished cells, and the change from a_t/b to x require separate error estimates; they are not consequences of translation counting alone.
Estimate C supplies a uniform bound as q,d,N vary; the fixed-modulus PNT does not supply that uniformity.
translation_average.evidence_status: Human-exposition identity source-inspected; not independently formalized by Symthaea.

finite_translation_oracle.method: Exhaustive finite check of the translate-count identity in cyclic groups C_n
finite_translation_oracle.subsets: Every nonempty subset T2 of each C_n
finite_translation_oracle.checked_identity: For every target s, exactly |T2| translates u satisfy s in u+T2. With chi_q in {-1,+1}, the row-filtered count satisfies 2*selected_count = |T2|*(1+chi_q).
limitations: Finite cyclic groups only; not a formal proof for the actual group H used in the RH construction.
Does not verify the theta-lift, cell-weight perturbations, prime density or any uniform analytic estimate.
The product-group oracle tests six finite abelian groups C_m × C_n; it is still not a Lean proof for the specific RH group H or a proof for all finite groups.

non_distinguished_cells.bound: For y >= exp(x^ε/3)/3, |G_χ(y)| <= y exp(-κ x^(ε/8)), where κ is independent of x,q,d.
